readings.Aries: You are already past the point of hesitation. You just haven't caught up to yourself yet. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Taurus: You've been working hard for a very long time. That is not the problem. The absence of rest is. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Gemini: Someone is taking your adaptability for granted. You have noticed. It's worth mentioning. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Cancer: The thing you've outgrown is still in your possession. It's okay to let it go. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Leo: The audience changes who you are. Spend some time today with no audience. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Virgo: There is a small pleasure available to you right now that your efficiency has been routing around. Take it. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Libra: You are harder to read than you think. Someone in your life is misreading you right now. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Scorpio: The obsession is information. What is it telling you about what you actually want? Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you said in passing planted something in someone else. It's still growing. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Capricorn: Something you've dismissed as not yet achievable is closer than the plan shows. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Aquarius: Something you built to be useful has become something you're attached to. Worth knowing. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Pisces: You have given people the version of yourself they could handle. Show someone the rest. Sleep on it before committing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
